example.deliver.title: Lewis wants an apple
example.deliver.description: Lewis is putting together a small fall display for the town square. Can you bring him a fresh Apple?
example.deliver.targetMessage: Beautiful, that's exactly what I had in mind. Thanks!
example.deliver.consequence.loved: Oh, you brought Lewis an apple? Those are my favorite, I hope he picks a nice spot for them.
example.deliver.consequence.hated: An apple for the display? Ugh, I can't stand the smell of those.
example.ship.title: Marnie's egg order
example.ship.description: Marnie is short on eggs for her shop. Could you ship 10 of any kind?
example.ship.targetMessage: Oh thank goodness, the shop has been wiped out.
example.catch.title: Willy's largemouth bass request
example.catch.description: Willy is putting together a sample of the lake's best. Can you bring him three Largemouth Bass?
example.slay.title: Marlon's slime clearing
example.slay.description: Marlon wants the upper mines thinned out. Slay 10 Green Slimes and let him know.
example.slay.objective: Slay 10 Green Slimes in the mines.
example.slay.targetMessage: Good work. The guild stays a little quieter today.
example.collect.title: Demetrius's mushroom survey
example.collect.description: Demetrius is sampling the fall canopy. Could you gather 5 Common Mushrooms?
example.collect.targetMessage: Great. These will round out the study nicely.
example.steps.title: Check on George
example.steps.description: Evelyn says George has been quieter than usual. Bring him a small gift, chat with him for a bit, then let her know how he's doing.
example.giftUnique.title: Linus's forage hand-outs
example.giftUnique.description: Linus wants to spread some forage around town. Gift any forage to three different villagers.
example.fishingTrip.title: Willy's gold-quality rainbow trout
example.fishingTrip.description: Willy wants three Gold-quality Rainbow Trout for a tasting. Catch them and bring them back.
example.fishingTrip.deliver: Deliver 3 Gold-quality Rainbow Trout to Willy.
example.visit.title: Drop by Leah's place
example.visit.description: Leah invited you over for a quick visit. Just walk into her house.
example.build.title: Robin's barn-raising tip
example.build.description: Robin says you should expand into livestock. Build a Barn on your farm.
example.build.step: Build a Barn on the farm.
example.reach.title: Marlon's mine goal
example.reach.description: Marlon wants you to reach floor 25 of the Mines and bring back a small ore haul.
example.reach.ship: Ship 20 ore (Copper, Iron, or Gold) through the bin.
example.plant.title: Linus's reforestation patch
example.plant.description: Linus is reseeding part of Cindersap. Plant 3 trees anywhere in the Forest.
example.clearWeeds.title: Spring cleaning the square
example.clearWeeds.description: Lewis wants Pelican Town tidied up. Clear 8 weeds.
example.clearDebris.title: Demetrius's backwoods clean-up
example.clearDebris.description: Demetrius is running an experiment in the Backwoods and needs the path cleared. Take down 5 resource clumps.
example.clearDebris.step: Clear 5 resource clumps in the Backwoods.
